entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you're speaking with Alex at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hello Alex. I'm calling about an order. I bought a pair of your cycling shoes a while back and they're just not working out for me. I'd like to return them.
I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your order number to start? And just to understand the situation better, what specifically is the issue with the shoes?
Sure, the order number is VF789-012. It's not a defect or anything. I've adjusted the cleats multiple times, but no matter what I do, they keep giving me painful blisters on any ride over an hour.
I'm sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our riders. Let me just pull up your order here... okay, I see you received the cycling shoes 44 days ago.
Yes, that sounds about right. Is that a problem?
Not at all. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you.

Oh, that's great news. I appreciate you making that easy. Since I did spend a lot of time trying to break them in and now I have to ship them back, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next VeloFit purchase? To help with buying a replacement pair.

I understand the frustration of having to start your search over. While I can't add a discount code on top of the full refund, I have just emailed you a prepaid shipping label to make the return process as convenient as possible. Once our warehouse receives the shoes, the refund will be issued to your original payment method.
Okay, a prepaid label works. That's fair enough. Thank you for your help, Alex.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
